_readme: Summoner names that mean Exiled — several accounts, including the RU server.
The active player is normally identified from the Live Client API itself,
which is reliable. This list is the fallback for EVENT names, where the
format differs and non-Latin names have already been seen in the wild
('Your creatures on team болтяра died'). If _is_me fails there, his own
kills and deaths route as ALLY events and she talks about him in the third
Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation, so typos in spacing do not
matter. A '#TAG' suffix is optional — both 'Exiled Rain' and
Add to this freely. An extra name that is never used costs nothing; a
missing one costs a whole game of misrouted events.
